common.title: Title

common.notFoundDescription: The item may have been removed or the address is wrong.
common.typeToSearch: Type at least 2 characters to search
common.jsonHint: Valid JSON object. The shape depends on the content type (see the original body beside).
common.error: This area could not be loaded.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Try again.
errors.invalid_input: Invalid data. Review the fields and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.duplicate: A record with the same identifier (slug or code) already exists.
errors.constraint: The data violates a database rule (e.g. premium requires a module).
errors.reference: Invalid reference: the related item no longer exists.
errors.cannot_publish_missing: Cannot approve: missing {fields}. Edit the content and try again.
errors.only_drafts_can_be_submitted: Only drafts can be submitted for review.
errors.already_in_review: This content is already in review.
errors.content_incomplete: Incomplete content: title and pillar are required.
errors.content_not_editable: Content is not editable in this state.
errors.version_has_no_items: The version has no items. Add at least one content before publishing.
errors.replacement_not_published: The replacement content must be published.
errors.item_not_found: Item not found in this version.
errors.version_published_readonly: Published version: create a new version to change items.
errors.reason_required: Provide a reason (required to hide or suspend).
errors.invalid_transition: Status transition not allowed for this actor.
errors.order_already_dispatched: Order already dispatched: it can no longer be cancelled.
errors.product_requires_image: A published product needs an image.
errors.food_product_requires_food_info: A published food product requires ingredients, allergens and storage.
errors.seller_not_own: Admin only creates or edits products of the own operation. Partner products are only moderated.
errors.self_dependency: A module cannot depend on itself.
errors.invalid_json: The body must be a valid JSON object.
errors.publish_at_future: The publication date must be in the future.
errors.media_license_mismatch: Media license inconsistent with the provider. Edit the content and try again.
errors.recipe_editor_pending: Recipe editing comes back with the new editor.
errors.recipe_incomplete: The recipe can't go live: missing {fields}.
errors.type_locked: A recipe's type doesn't change (and other content doesn't become a recipe).
errors.recipe_body_managed: This recipe's body only changes through the recipe editor.
errors.review_required_protected: The review rule only changes through the audited settings action.
errors.justification_required: Give a justification with at least 5 characters.
errors.credentials_empty: The hero has no credentials request to approve.
errors.request_changed: The hero edited the request after the queue was opened. Reload the page and read the new text before deciding.
errors.review_flow_unavailable: This type has no “Submit for review” in the hero portal. Review can only be turned on for recipes.
errors.hero_categories_max_2: Each hero can have at most 2 categories.
errors.library_tab_label_pt_required: To translate the name, also fill in the pt-BR name.

content.title: Content
content.description: Editorial review, publishing, featuring and editing of any content.

detail.bodyMissing: This content has no body/media yet. Approval is blocked until one exists.
detail.noAccessRule: No access rule: the content shows as “temporarily unavailable” to the public.
detail.linkOrigin: Origin of the link to the hero
detail.previewBanner: Review preview: this is how the recipe looks in the app, even as a draft or in review.

summary.video: Video · {points, plural, =1 {1 key point} other {# key points}} · {transcript, plural, =1 {1 transcript segment} other {# transcript segments}}
summary.recipe: Recipe · {ingredients, plural, =1 {1 ingredient} other {# ingredients}} · {steps, plural, =1 {1 step} other {# steps}} · {servings, plural, =1 {1 serving} other {# servings}}
summary.workout: Workout · {blocks, plural, =1 {1 block} other {# blocks}} · {exercises, plural, =1 {1 exercise} other {# exercises}}
summary.guide: Guide · {sections, plural, =1 {1 section} other {# sections}} · {points, plural, =1 {1 key point} other {# key points}}
summary.recipeCounts: Recipe · {ingredients, plural, =1 {1 ingredient} other {# ingredients}} · {steps, plural, =1 {1 step} other {# steps}}

review.title: Editorial decision
review.description: Approve publishes the content (requires access rule and body). Return keeps the draft with feedback. Reject closes the round.
review.feedbackHint: Recorded in the review round and in the audit trail.
review.notInReview: No open round: decisions apply to the round in review. Even so, the admin may approve/return directly.

statusActions.title: Publication status
statusActions.publishDescription: Publishes without going through review. Check access rule and body first.
statusActions.archiveDescription: Leaves the catalog. Programs that depend on it may need a substitution.
statusActions.archiveRecipeWarning: Recipe: safety takedown only. It cannot go back live until the new editor ships, because older recipes do not yet meet the publishing checklist (allergens, times).
statusActions.publishNowDescription: Drops the schedule and puts the content live immediately.

form.createDescription: Pick the hero in charge and fill in the fields. The content starts as a draft.
form.editDescription: Admin edits any field, including access rule, module and completion mode.
form.creatorHint: Fictional heroes are marked in the list.

typeSettings.title: Completion defaults by type
typeSettings.description: Sets whether each type completes automatically (when reaching the progress threshold) or manually. A content item can override the default.
typeSettings.caption: Settings by content type
typeSettings.thresholdHint: Between 1 and 100. Used only in automatic mode.

schedule.title: Scheduling
schedule.hint: Optional. Empty = publish now. Time in your device's time zone ({tz}).
schedule.hintNoTz: Optional. Empty = publish now. Time in your device's time zone.
schedule.publish_at_future: The date must be in the future (at least 1 minute ahead).

programs.title: Programs
programs.description: Versioned programs: participants stay on the version they joined.

create.title: New program
create.description: Creates the program (draft) and its first version. Publish the version after adding items.

detail.newVersionDescription: Active participants stay on the version they joined. The new version starts as a draft.
detail.archiveDescription: Leaves the catalog; existing enrollments are preserved.
detail.noVersions: This program has no versions yet.

version.title: Title
version.certificateFieldsHint: Fields frozen in the certificate issued on completion.
version.itemsDescription: Search published content by title and add it. Required items count towards completion; participants may follow any order.
version.noItems: No items yet. Add published content.
version.readOnly: Published version: items are frozen. Use substitutions to swap an archived required item, or create a new version.
version.substitutionsDescription: Swaps a required item (e.g. archived) for published content, applying to all pending participants of this version. Auditable.
version.publishDescription: It becomes the current version for new enrollments. Already enrolled participants stay on the version they joined.

concept.title: Concept
concept.description: The conceptual part shown on the program page, right below the header, in the program's own voice. Leave everything empty to show only the description.
concept.ideaHint: 2 to 3 sentences in the program's voice: what it is and what it believes in. Between {min} and {max} characters.
concept.notForHint: Optional (shown in a muted tone). Up to {max} characters.
concept.outcomesHint: {min} to {max} concrete outcomes consistent with the contents. No promised results (e.g. weight lost).
concept.methodHint: {min} to {max} steps, in the suggested order, pointing to the version's contents.
concept.rangeHint: Whole number between {min} and {max}, or empty.
concept.rhythmHint: Optional, up to 140 characters. Duration in weeks comes from "Estimated weeks".
concept.needsHint: Equipment or ingredients, up to {max} items. With no items, the page shows "Nothing but yourself".
concept.careHint: Required, between {min} and {max} characters. Keep the notices: educational content, stop if you feel pain, allergens.
concept.unsupported: The database doesn't have the program concept yet (migration 0048). The page keeps showing the description.
concept.noSourceConcept: The original version has no concept yet.
concept.translationHint: Applies when the translation is published. Empty = the page uses the original concept.

plans.title: Plans and modules
plans.description: Modules are the unit of entitlement; plans are presentation bundles. Everything is simulated.

modules.title: Modules
modules.caption: Module list
modules.name: Name
modules.priceHint: Demo amount in cents (e.g. 2990 = R$ 29.90). No real charge.

dependencies.title: Module dependencies
dependencies.description: To select a module the user must hold the required modules. By default, FULL modules do not require Base.
dependencies.selfHint: The module itself is not listed (no self-dependency).

bundles.title: Plans (bundles)
bundles.caption: Plan list
bundles.name: Name
bundles.isFreeHint: A free plan includes no modules.

featured.title: Featured
featured.description: Order of the featured items shown on Home. Position 1 appears first.
featured.empty: Nothing featured. Add from the search.
featured.previewDescription: How the featured items appear on the home page, in the current order.
featured.onlyPublished: Only published items appear on Home; the others are listed here with a warning.

translations.title: Translations
translations.description: Manual translations per language. Untranslated content stays in its original language with a tag; nothing is machine-translated here.
translations.empty: No translation for this language yet.
translations.note: Each language is saved separately. Only published translations replace the original in the interface. Without a translation, the user sees the original with the language tag.
translations.choose: Pick an item from the search to start.

products.title: Products
products.description: Moderation of all products. The own operation can be edited here; partner products are only moderated.

detail.significantHint: Significant changes (title, category, type, attributes, food info) automatically suspend validated links.
detail.partnerReadOnly: Partner product: read-only here. The admin moderates; the seller edits in its own portal.
detail.ownEditable: Own-operation product: the admin can edit it.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Hiding or suspending requires a reason. Clearing returns the product to the catalog (if published and available).

form.createDescription: Demo product of the own operation. Illustrative prices; no real sale.
form.noOwnOrg: No organization of kind “own operation” found.

links.title: Content–product links
links.description: Only validated links are shown to the public. Significant product changes automatically suspend validated links.

actions.validateDescription: The link becomes visible to the public, recording the current product version.

create.title: Create link manually
create.description: Pick a content item and a product. The link is created and then validated.
create.pickBoth: Pick a content item and a product.

orders.title: Test orders
orders.description: Demo orders from all users. No real amount was charged.
orders.banner: Test orders — no real amount. Fictional destinations, no address, no delivery.

detail.destinationNote: Predefined destination, with no real address or geolocation.
detail.eta: Simulated ETA: {n, plural, =1 {1 day} other {# days}}

actions.transitionDescription: Administrative transition recorded in the fulfillment timeline.
actions.cancelDescription: Only possible while no fulfillment has been dispatched. All pending fulfillments are cancelled.
actions.noTransitions: No transitions available in this state.

shopFilters.title: Shop filters
shopFilters.description: Chips at the top of the Shop tab. Each filter shows the products of the checked categories and the hand-picked ones.
shopFilters.unavailable: Filters are not available in this database yet (apply migration 0047). The shop shows only “All”.
shopFilters.listDescription: Inactive filters or filters with no visible product don't appear in the shop.
shopFilters.allFixed: “All” is fixed and always comes first.
shopFilters.empty: No filters. The shop shows only “All”.
shopFilters.noRule: No category or product: the filter stays hidden.
shopFilters.deleteDescription: The chip leaves the shop. Products are not changed.
shopFilters.dialogDescription: A product is in the filter if it belongs to one of the checked categories OR is in the hand-picked list.
shopFilters.slugHint: Shown in /shop?filtro=…: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
shopFilters.activeHint: Shows the chip in the shop when there is a visible product.
shopFilters.categoriesHint: All visible products in these categories.
shopFilters.productsHint: Added to the categories. Unpublished products don't appear in the shop.

heroCategories.title: Hero categories
heroCategories.description: Chips at the top of the Hero tab. Each hero has up to 2 categories, chosen on the hero's screen.
heroCategories.unavailable: Categories are not available in this database yet (apply migration 0049). The Hero tab shows only “All”.
heroCategories.listDescription: Inactive categories or categories without an active hero do not appear in the Hero tab.
heroCategories.allFixed: “All” is fixed and always comes first.
heroCategories.empty: No categories. The Hero tab shows only “All”.
heroCategories.deleteDescription: The chip leaves the Hero tab and heroes lose this category. Heroes are not changed in any other way.
heroCategories.dialogDescription: The category says who the hero is (e.g. Sports, Music). Heroes are linked on each hero's screen.
heroCategories.slugHint: Shows in /personalities?categoria=…: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
heroCategories.activeHint: Shows the chip in the Hero tab when there is an active hero.

field.title: Categories
field.description: Up to 2 categories, in order. They set the Hero tab chips and the card badges.
field.unavailable: Categories are not available in this database yet (apply migration 0049).

tabs.title: Hero page shortcuts
tabs.description: Per category: name, icon, order and whether it shows. What feeds each shortcut is fixed; the hero's main category decides, and each hero can have exceptions on their own screen.
tabs.unavailable: Configurable shortcuts are not available in this database yet (apply migration 0050). Hero pages use the default shortcuts.
tabs.noCategories: Create a category to configure the shortcuts.
tabs.rules: A shortcut with no items is hidden (Food always shows). The shortcut address does not change when the name changes.
tabs.duplicate: Heads up: visible shortcuts with the same name ({labels}).
tabs.heroDescription: What this hero shows comes from the main category. Change here only what is an exception.
tabs.noCategory: No category: the app's default shortcuts apply.
